settings.content: The investor filings (about 340 MB) are too large for a theme, so they load from another address. Leave this as it is while the Vercel site is running. To move them, upload the files to Content > Files and paste the address of that folder here, up to the last slash before the file name.

settings.label: Documents address
settings.info: The files are read from this address followed by /assets/investors/<file name>, unless it ends in /files/, in which case the file name follows directly.
